name: gymcast
description: GymCast — fitness prediction markets (monorepo root: convenience scripts only)

scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
